external_audit.opinion_detail: Unmodified opinion on the financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2025. Audit completed under ISA (UK) 600 Revised group audit (parent + Berneslai Homes + Barnsley Community Build / Community Assets). Per Grant Thornton: backstop regulations not applicable to Barnsley Council as accounts have been audited and published without delays for the last seven years with unqualified audit opinions.
external_audit.vfm_conclusion: No significant weaknesses identified in arrangements for securing value for money during 2024/25.
key_concerns: Note 19A Property Plant & Equipment Net Book Value at 1 April 2024 misstated (£4,489k buildings, £3,076k vehicles/plant/furniture/equipment) corrected during audit

Council holds significant levels of debt from new secondary school estate + Glassworks town centre development (s151 officer warning, paragraph 3.20 of MTFS); new debt in MTFS contingent on savings plan delivery

mtfs_2026_31.title: MTFS / Budget Proposals 2026/29 (3-year horizon)
mtfs_2026_31.savings_strategy: No savings proposed for 2026/27 - budget balanced via reserves draw of £6.8M as temporary bridging strategy pending longer-term savings plan to be developed by summer 2026
mtfs_2026_31.annual_gap_run_rate_note: circa £30M p.a. by end of planning cycle (28/29) per s151 officer paragraph 3.9
mtfs_2026_31.unidentified_gap_note: Long-term savings plan to be developed and brought forward as part of 27/28 budget; 4-point savings plan agreed in principle but no specific proposals quantified for 2026/27
mtfs_2026_31.fair_funding_2_0_impact: Provisional Local Government Finance Settlement (3-year settlement) generates additional £20.3M over period 2026/27-2028/29 (£8.9M in 2026/27)

dsg_send.safety_valve_status: 5-year Safety Valve Agreement signed with DfE - received £9.16M additional DSG on 31 March 2023 plus £1.75M in 2024/25
dsg_send.safety_valve_terms: Commits Council to managing DSG into in-year balance + implementing DSG Management Plan
dsg_send.send_strategy: 1% transfer of schools block to high needs (DfE approval required for >0.5%); funding to commission new SEND places in local Barnsley schools to stem placements in costly independent settings

lgr.context: Barnsley is a metropolitan borough within South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority (SYMCA). No live LGR consultation. Council has £100M share of South Yorkshire Renewal Fund earmarked for Place Based Investment Plan

property_strategy.name: Capital Investment Strategy (referenced in MTFS Section 6)
property_strategy.major_active_schemes: Glassworks town centre development (capital cost increased to £210M, £139.3M borrowed); new secondary school estate (BSF era)
property_strategy.borrowing_concern: Council may need to take out £90m loan in next two years (s151 officer statement); future borrowing must be subject to strict diligence given current debt levels and severe budget pressures. New debt only progressed contingent on savings plan delivery (paragraph 3.21 MTFS).

actionable_savings_levers_summary: Unidentified savings runway: £30M p.a. annual gap by 28/29 with zero savings yet identified for 26/27 - entire savings plan to be developed by summer 2026 (4-point plan agreed in principle)
Glassworks regeneration: £210M capital cost (double 2017 estimate), £139.3M borrowed - review revenue financing affordability and any future tranches
Children’s Social Care £12M overspend driver - placement costs / agency staffing in LAC; transformation savings potential vs current run-rate
DSG/SEND £17.8M cumulative deficit - statutory override extended to 2028; Safety Valve programme in delivery (year 3 of 5)
Glassworks management contract - verify procurement basis and term following commissioning
Berneslai Homes ALMO - first ALMO to receive C1 RSH rating in 2024; opportunity to review management fee benchmarking
External Best Value review commissioned for 2026 covering all council services - will surface efficiency savings
